statement.zh: 教科文将墨西哥城历史中心与霍奇米尔科列入世界遗产，覆盖特诺奇蒂特兰叠压城市景观（UNESCO 412）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Historic Centre of Mexico City and Xochimilco as World Heritage, covering Tenochtitlan's superimposed urban landscape (UNESCO 412).
